proof_summary: Take the explicit counterexample \(n=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009\), where the three prime-power factors are pairwise coprime. Multiplicativity gives \(\sigma(n)=32767\cdot4410\cdot458010\) and \(\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma(d)=65519\cdot4411\cdot458011\), so \(a(n)=2\sigma(n)-\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma(d)=1\), although \(n\ne1,12\).
